comment:
* BigInteger utilities.
 * @hide This class is not part of the Android public SDK API

variables.name: SMALL_PRIMES_PRODUCT
variables.comment: Hexadecimal value of the product of the 131 smallest odd primes from 3 to 743

methods.name: public static byte[] asUnsignedByteArray(BigInteger value)
methods.comment:
* Return the passed in value as an unsigned byte array.
     * 
     * @param value the value to be converted.
     * @return a byte array without a leading zero byte if present in the signed encoding.

methods.name: public static byte[] asUnsignedByteArray(int length, BigInteger value)
methods.comment:
* Return the passed in value as an unsigned byte array of the specified length, padded with
     * leading zeros as necessary..
     *
     * @param length
     *            the fixed length of the result
     * @param value
     *            the value to be converted.
     * @return a byte array padded to a fixed length with leading zeros.

methods.name: public static void asUnsignedByteArray(BigInteger value, byte[] buf, int off, int len)
methods.comment: * Write the passed in value as unsigned bytes to the specified buffer range, padded with * leading zeros as necessary. * * @param value * the value to be converted. * @param buf * the buffer to which the value is written. * @param off * the start offset in array buf at which the data is written. * @param len * the fixed length of data written (possibly padded with leading zeros).

methods.name: public static BigInteger createRandomInRange(BigInteger min, BigInteger max, SecureRandom random)
methods.comment:
* Return a random BigInteger not less than 'min' and not greater than 'max'
     * 
     * @param min the least value that may be generated
     * @param max the greatest value that may be generated
     * @param random the source of randomness
     * @return a random BigInteger value in the range [min,max]

methods.name: public static BigInteger fromUnsignedByteArray(byte[] buf, int off, int length)
public static BigInteger modOddInverse(BigInteger M, BigInteger X)
public static BigInteger modOddInverseVar(BigInteger M, BigInteger X)
public static BigInteger createRandomBigInteger(int bitLength, SecureRandom random)
methods.comment:
* Return a positive BigInteger in the range of 0 to 2**bitLength - 1.
     *
     * @param bitLength maximum bit length for the generated BigInteger.
     * @param random a source of randomness.
     * @return a positive BigInteger

methods.name: public static BigInteger createRandomPrime(int bitLength, int certainty, SecureRandom random)
methods.comment:
* Return a prime number candidate of the specified bit length.
     *
     * @param bitLength bit length for the generated BigInteger.
     * @param random a source of randomness.
     * @return a positive BigInteger of numBits length

methods.name: private static byte[] createRandom(int bitLength, SecureRandom random) throws IllegalArgumentException
